name: Sinochem International Corporation
summary: Sinochem International Corporation manufactures and sells chemical new materials and intermediates, new materials, polymer additives, and natural rubber businesses internationally. The company offers pesticide intermediates, electronic chemicals, and pharmaceutical intermediates; and ultraviolet absorbent, light stabilizers, polymerization inhibitors, and antioxidants. It also offers epoxy resin, including fibers, membrane, and lightweight materials. In addition, the company provides lithium batteries and materials.
